messages:
maya: kicked off a cross-pop latency sweep for mix-llama3-small-int8 with edge-wavelength routing enabled.
joel: numbers?
maya: us-east (h100, fused_attn_v2): p50 30ms, p95 95ms, qps 22 @conc=8
maya: us-west (h100, fused_attn_v2): p50 32ms, p95 260ms, qps 16
maya: eu-west (h100, fused_attn_v2): p50 35ms, p95 140ms, qps 18
sam: west tail awful. traces show extra wavelength hop in ~28% of requests leading to kv warmup misses
maya: trace excerpt:
```
[req=7a2d] client->edge-usw->wavelength-hop->proxy-d->model-h100
warmup: prefix_cache_miss x40
retransmits: 2
total_latency: 244ms
```
infra-bot: net.alert: elevated tcp_retransmits detected in us-west window 2495123000-2495123200
ops-jen: reprovisioned proxy-d (hotswap) at 2495123300 :white_check_mark:
maya: post-hotswap quicks:
- us-west fused_attn_v2: p50 33ms, p95 138ms, qps 18
- us-west attention_sparse_kernel: p50 46ms, p95 92ms, qps 16
- us-west fused_attn_v1: p50 31ms, p95 150ms, qps 17
tess: sparse kernel lowers tail but increases median, likely due to merge behaviour and mem copies; need eval guardrails
sam: capacity check: pin routing to local-pop (no wavelength hop)
maya: pinned local-pop: us-west qps -> 24, p50 30ms, p95 84ms. local routing improves both tail and throughput
joel: proposed plan:
1) latency-tier routes -> local-first routing policy (canary 5%)
2) enable attention_sparse_kernel on latency-tier for p95-sensitive routes (canary)
3) reprovision wavelength node to avoid fanout
ops-jen: cost note: attention_sparse_kernel ~+9% GPU cycles per token median increase. logged to cost dashboard.
tess: will create eval suite (prompt sets: summarization-long, code-complete, instruction-follow) to catch quality regressions from sparse kernel quantization
maya: starting 2h 5% canary with local-first + sparse kernel now, posting interim after 20m
maya: 20m update: canary us-west p95 ~95ms, no error uptick, logs: https://logs.redwood/trace/7a2d
sam: add a quick KV prime on cold-starts to reduce warmup misses for small contexts
joel: if 1h stable with p95 <120ms we'll roll to 25% tomorrow else revert
ops-jen: INF-3350 created to track reprovision and routing policy rollout :memo:
maya: will post final 2h summary here. :thumbsup:
